rawText: [{"path":"packages/runtime-vapor/src/components/KeepAlive.ts","from_line":356,"to_line":364,"why":"When the KeepAlive component is unmounted, this onBeforeUnmount teardown walks each cached branch and decides its fate: the branch matching the current key is kept (shape flag unset and deactivated hook queued so it unmounts as part of keep-alive), while every other cached branch is removed outright from its container, with a fallback for same-tick branches marked keep-alive but not yet cached."}]

[{"path": "packages/runtime-vapor/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 356, "to_line": 364, "why": "In KeepAlive's onBeforeUnmount teardown, this loop decides each cached branch's fate: the branch matching the current key is kept (deactivated so it unmounts with KeepAlive itself), while every other cached branch has its shape flag reset and is removed outright from the DOM, with the fallback deactivating a live current block that was never cached."}]
